entry.description: Viplan is Raul Espejo's method and methodology for using organisational cybernetics and the Viable System Model in diagnosis, design and implementation work.

profile.title: Viplan
profile.canonical_definition: Viplan is Raul Espejo's method and methodology for using organisational cybernetics and the Viable System Model in diagnosis, design and implementation work.
profile.summary: Viplan combines organisational cybernetics, identity work and the VSM in a method and methodology for diagnosis, design and implementation.
profile.why_it_matters: It makes the move from a cybernetic model to organised inquiry and intervention explicit, reducing the common error of treating the VSM diagram itself as a complete method.
common_misreadings: all organisations have one obvious system in focus
profile.editorial_note: Developed from public primary, institutional and publisher sources. Open to correction, rival interpretation and stronger evidence.
